-- Liaisons Rose de Damas (ghost_variety_id = 1)
SELECT gvm.ghost_variety_id, gvm.molecule_id, gvm.link_type, gvm.percentage, m.name 
FROM ghost_variety_molecules gvm 
JOIN molecules m ON gvm.molecule_id = m.id 
WHERE gvm.ghost_variety_id = 1 
LIMIT 10;
